bio.text: Michael A. Chiaradio is the Democratic candidate for Mississippi's 3rd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
He is originally from New Jersey, holds a master's degree from Felician University, and previously worked as a supervisor for Maximus, a government contractor.
He moved to Shubuta, Mississippi, in 2023 to own and work on a regenerative farm.

sources.title: Meet the Candidates for Mississippi's 3rd Congressional District in the Nov. 3 Elections
